title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 9.8279e-3 eV²
  λ_q = 0.018511
  m_eff = 2.3249e-1 eV
  T_vev = 5.1523e-1 m⁻²
  ω = 0.2411 s⁻¹
  k = 0.0656 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.272137 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = 5.200e-1
  J_spin = 3.959e-2
